title: Analysis of the impact of digitization on processes and efficiency in the area of nursing and patient management at a university hospital
summary: In September 2022, a new technology called the Digital Patient Call System was introduced at Rostock University Medicine. This technology helps with nursing and patient management by serving as an information and coordination tool. At the patients' bedsides, there are tablet computers called Bedside Terminals. These allow patients to communicate with the nursing staff and request certain services. By using this digital technology, nursing tasks can be better organized and carried out more efficiently. This saves time and effort for the nursing staff. The company "Cliniserve" provides data on how often patients use the call system, what kind of assistance they request, and how long it takes for their requests to be processed. This data is analyzed in an anonymized manner and in compliance with data protection regulations. We want to examine how this new technology affects patient management and the satisfaction of nursing staff.
